QF.id: IV Introduction to Interest Rate Derivatives_4

question.text: In exchange-traded interest rate futures globally (as of March 2025), the notional outstanding amount was approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the BIS exchange-traded derivatives table cited in the workbook, global exchange-traded interest rate futures had notional outstanding of approximately USD 44,861 billion as of March 2025. The Trap: The other figures correspond to different categories in the same BIS table and do not match interest rate futures. The stem refers to the global figure — the table is global, not India-specific. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), page 97.
